# 4 Ezra Chapter 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Eagle vision (Rome)

---

**11:1** Then I dreamed a dream, and behold! there rose from the sea an eagle which had twelve feathered wings and three heads.

**11:2** And I saw, and behold: it spread its wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the sky blew upon it, and clouds gathered about it.

**11:3** And I saw: from its wings there grew other wings on the opposite side; and they became small and little.

**11:4** But its heads were at rest; the middle head was greater than the other heads, but it too rested with them.

**11:5** And I saw, and behold: the eagle flew with its wings to reign over the earth and over those who dwell upon it.

**11:6** And I saw how all things under heaven were brought into subjection to it, and no one spoke against it, not even any creature that was on the earth.

**11:7** And I saw the eagle stand upon its talons and give voice to its feathers, saying:

**11:8** Do not all wake at once! Let each sleep in his own place, and wake in order; but let the heads be kept for the last.

**11:9** And I looked, and behold: the voice did not come from its heads, but from the midst of its body.

**11:10** And I counted the other wings on the opposite side, and there were eight of them.

**11:11** And I saw, and behold: on the right side one wing arose and it reigned over all the earth;

**11:12** and it came to pass when it reigned, it ended and disappeared, so that its place appeared no more; then the next arose and reigned, and it also held rule for a long time.

**11:13** And it came to pass when it reigned also, it ended, so that it disappeared like the first.

**11:14** And behold, a voice was sent to it and said:

**11:15** Hear me, you who have held rule over the earth all this time! I declare this to you before you disappear:

**11:16** None after you shall hold rule as long as you, not even half as long.

**11:17** Then the third arose and held rule as the former ones; and it also disappeared.

**11:18** And so it went with all the wings, one after another, each ruling and then disappearing.

**11:19** And I saw, and behold: in due time the wings on the right side also rose up; some of them ruled but disappeared suddenly, while others arose but held rule not.

**11:20** And after this I saw, and behold: the twelve wings and the two little wings disappeared.

**11:21** And in the body of the eagle nothing remained save the three heads which were at rest, and six little wings.

**11:22** And I saw, and behold: two little wings separated from the six and stayed under the head on the right side; but the other four stayed in their place.

**11:23** And I saw, and behold: these four under-wings purposed to set themselves up and to hold rule.

**11:24** And I saw, and behold: one was set up, but disappeared suddenly.

**11:25** A second also, and this disappeared more quickly than the first.

**11:26** And I saw, and behold: the two which remained were themselves purposed to reign;

**11:27** and while they so purposed, behold, one of the heads that were at rest — that which was in the midst — woke up; for it was greater than the two other heads.

**11:28** And I saw how it allied the two heads with itself;

**11:29** and behold! the head turned with those who were with it, and consumed the two under-wings that were purposed to reign.

**11:30** Moreover this head gained control of the whole earth and oppressed with great oppression those who dwell therein; and it had greater power over the world than all the wings which had gone before.

**11:31** And after this I saw, and behold: the middle head also disappeared suddenly, as the wings had done.

**11:32** But there remained the two heads, which also in like manner ruled over the earth and over those who dwell therein.

**11:33** And I saw, and behold: the head on the right side devoured the one on the left.

**11:34** Then I heard a voice which said to me: Look before you and consider what you see!

**11:35** And I saw, and behold: a creature like a lion was roused out of the forest roaring; and I heard how it raised a man's voice to the eagle and said:

**11:36** Hear me! I will speak to you. The Most High says to you:

**11:37** Are you not the one that remains of the four beasts which I made to reign in my world, so that the end of my times might come through them?

**11:38** You, the fourth who came, and overcame all the beasts that came before, and held rule over the world with much terror, and over all the earth with grievous oppression;

**11:39** and so long a time you dwelt in the world with deceit, and you judged the earth not with truth;

**11:40** for you have afflicted the meek and injured the peaceable and hated the truthful and loved liars; and you have destroyed the dwellings of those who brought forth fruit, and thrown down the walls of those who did you no harm.

**11:41** Your insolence has reached the Most High and your pride the Mighty One.

**11:42** And the Most High has looked upon his times: and behold, they are ended, and his ages are completed!

**11:43** Therefore you will surely disappear, O eagle — you and your terrible wings and your hateful feathers and your evil heads and your dreadful claws and your whole vain body —

**11:44** so that the whole earth, freed from your violence, may be refreshed and renewed, and may hope for the judgment and the mercy of him who made it.
